title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN & FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging and embedded cover art)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a strong show highlighted by Bird Song, Tennessee Jed and a smoking Scarlet > Fire sequence.
ai_review.review: The Hunter‑Seamons matrix is crisp, lovingly remastered and praised as “A‑level” and “excellent,” delivering clear sound throughout. Musically the concert shines with Bird Song, Tennessee Jed and an especially fiery first half of set 2 (Scarlet > Fire), while the overall energy remains high despite a few listeners finding the setlist a bit iffy.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong show comments (standout songs, high energy) combined with uniformly positive remarks about an excellent matrix recording yields a rating above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, lovely sound; well‑remastered by Hunter Seamons; no notable dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid pacing with a strong first half of set 2; overall setlist praised despite some subjective doubts about song choices.
